item_title: Sources: Twitter starts cutting an unspecified number of contractors in various fields, including content moderation, real estate, marketing, and others
item_description: Ina Fried / Axios:  — After laying off half its staff earlier this month, Twitter on Saturday started culling its vast ranks of contract staff, sources confirmed to Axios.
